# Preprocessing Decisions

*Generated by `python main.py preprocess` on 2026-11-09 11:24. Numbers are computed from the data at run time.*

| # | Decision | Reason (evidence from `reports/dataset_audit.md`) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Use only Kolkata, 2018-06-16 to 2020-07-01 (747 days) | Before 2018-06-16: AQI missing 59 days in a row (2018-04-18 to 2018-06-15); CO = 0 for 47 days and Toluene = 0 for 8 days (likely 'no reading' stored as 0). After it, AQI is unbroken. |
| 2 | Raw file never modified | Cleaned table saved separately to `data/processed/kolkata_daily_clean.csv`. |
| 3 | Drop Xylene | 51.6 % missing for Kolkata, only recorded from mid-2019. |
| 4 | Inputs: past AQI + 11 pollutants + day-of-year (sin/cos) | All available in the CSV. No weather or external data added. Day-of-year is known in advance, so it is not future information. |
| 5 | AQI (target) never filled | AQI missing days inside the period: 0. The code stops with an error if this ever changes. |
| 6 | Input gaps forward-filled, flagged | Cells filled: 1 (O3: ['2018-06-17']). Forward fill copies the previous day's value, so it uses only the past. Each filled cell is marked in a `<column>_imputed` column. |
| 7 | Chronological split by forecast date | Train 2018-06-16 to 2019-09-30 (472 days, 125 with AQI > 200); validation 2019-10-01 to 2019-12-31 (92 days, 39 high); test 2020-01-01 to 2020-07-01 (183 days, 34 high). A plain 70/15/15 split left only 2 high days in test, so the alert could not be evaluated. Cut-offs were fixed from the AQI distribution before any model was trained. |
| 8 | No random shuffling across time | Splits are blocks of consecutive dates; training batches may be shuffled *within* the training period only. |
| 9 | Scaler fitted on training period only | Mean / std from train rows; the same numbers are reused for validation and test (`data/processed/scaler.json`). |
| 10 | Lookback 14 days, horizon 1 day | Each sample uses days t-13..t to predict AQI on day t+1. A validation/test sample may use history from the end of the previous period (that is still the past, so it is allowed); its target is always inside its own period. |
| 11 | Alert rule: predicted AQI > 200 | Project requirement (CPCB 'Poor' category starts at 201). |

Known limitations carried forward: about 2 years of data (two winters); the test period includes the COVID-19 lockdown (from 2020-03-25), which changed pollution patterns; no weather data.
